lead.headline: TWO ENGINEERING STUDENTS KILLED, FOUR INJURED IN BENGALURU RURAL CRASH
lead.deck: The second-year Sapthagiri College students were travelling to a college outreach activity when their car hit a roadside tree near Gudemaranahalli early Tuesday; police say the cause is still under investigation.
paragraphs: Two 19-year-old engineering students, Janavi and Vaishnavi, were killed and four classmates were injured when their car crashed into a roadside tree near Gudemaranahalli in Bengaluru South district on Tuesday morning.

The second-year Sapthagiri College of Engineering students were travelling to Hutridurga near Kunigal for a college outreach programme. Police said the car appeared to lose control before hitting the tree.
The four injured students were taken to hospital. The exact circumstances leading to the crash are still being investigated.

image.alt: The car that crashed into a roadside tree near Gudemaranahalli in Bengaluru South district.
image.caption: The crash site near Gudemaranahalli. Express photo / Special Arrangement.

sidebarStory.headline: MS DHONI RETIRES FROM IPL, TAKES UP CHENNAI SUPER KINGS MENTOR ROLE
sidebarStory.subhead: The five-time IPL-winning captain will begin as CSK’s Team Mentor in 2027, ending a playing career in the league that spanned nearly two decades.
paragraphs: Chennai Super Kings announced Tuesday that Mahendra Singh Dhoni has retired as an IPL player and will become the franchise’s Team Mentor for the 2027 season.
Dhoni led CSK to five IPL titles and made 272 appearances for the side. The announcement came on the league’s player-retention deadline.

image.alt: MS Dhoni, in a photograph accompanying news of his IPL retirement and new Chennai Super Kings mentor role.
image.caption: MS Dhoni. The Times of India.

stories.headline: KARNATAKA PLANS POLICE-LED HOUSEHOLD SURVEY ACROSS BENGALURU
paragraphs: Chief Minister D K Shivakumar says the state will direct police to build household-level records of Bengaluru residents, citing public safety and the need to know who lives where.
The announcement followed publication of revised electoral rolls. A Home Department official told The Indian Express that implementation details have not yet been discussed.

stories.headline: TUNNEL ROAD PLANS SHIFT TO SPARE LALBAGH; FOUR ALTERNATIVES UNDER STUDY
paragraphs: The state has decided against acquiring land inside Lalbagh Botanical Garden for the Hebbal–Silk Board tunnel road after objections over potential damage to its biodiversity and ancient rock formations.
Officials are assessing four possible alignments before a feasibility report goes to the Cabinet; route changes could affect cost and timing.

stories.headline: SWEDEN SEEKS INDIAN ENGINEERS TO FILL 18,000 TECH SPECIALIST VACANCIES
paragraphs: Sweden’s ambassador to India, Petra Menander, says her country needs about 18,000 technology specialists and is looking to attract skilled Indian professionals.
Last year, about 2,600 Indians applied for their first Swedish work permits, mainly in high-skilled fields, she said in an interview in Bengaluru.

groups.ariaLabel: India court decisions, public safety and shipping news

stories.headline: SUPREME COURT GRANTS BAIL TO TWO CONVICTS IN BILKIS BANO CASE
paragraphs: The Supreme Court suspended the life sentences of Bipinchand Joshi and Pradeep Modhiya and granted them conditional bail while their appeals remain pending.
The bench noted they had spent more than 17 years in prison; one has a severe disability. The order was uploaded on the Court’s website this week.

stories.headline: 17 KILLED, 38 INJURED IN FIVE UTTARAKHAND CRASHES IN 24 HOURS
paragraphs: Five accidents in Tehri Garhwal and Rudraprayag districts between Monday night and Tuesday morning killed at least 17 people and injured 38, police said.
In the deadliest incident, a bus carrying 34 passengers plunged about 100 metres into a gorge near Gular bridge; nine people died and 25 were injured.

stories.headline: INDIA CONDEMNS TANKER ATTACK; ONE INDIAN SEAFARER REMAINS MISSING
paragraphs: India condemned the attack on Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT Tara Gas in the Strait of Hormuz. Of 24 Indian nationals aboard, 21 reached shore safely, two were taken to hospital and one remains missing.
The Indian Embassy in Oman is coordinating with local authorities on search and rescue efforts, the Ministry of External Affairs said.

groups.ariaLabel: India energy, technology and culture news

stories.headline: INDIAN OIL’S PANIPAT UNIT READY TO PRODUCE INDIA’S FIRST COMMERCIAL SAF
paragraphs: Indian Oil’s first commercial-scale sustainable aviation fuel plant at Panipat has received approvals to begin production, using used cooking oil as feedstock.
The 30,000-tonne-a-year plant produced its first batch on Monday and could meet nearly all of India’s proposed 2027 sustainable aviation fuel blending requirement for international flights.

stories.headline: IBM CHIEF SAYS AI AGENTS COULD DISPLACE ABOUT 10% OF WORKERS IN FIVE YEARS
paragraphs: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna told NDTV that AI could handle about half of the world’s mainly white-collar work over the next five years, potentially displacing roughly 10% of workers.
He said new roles may also grow around building, maintaining and checking AI agents, but society should prepare alternative employment pathways for affected workers.

stories.headline: TAMIL SONG “VARUVAAIY” EARNS FIRST-EVER GRAMMY NOMINATION FOR THE LANGUAGE
paragraphs: “Varuvaaiy,” composed by Devan Ekambaram and featuring vocalist Susha, has been nominated for Best Global Music Performance at the 69th Grammy Awards.
The song reimagines a devotional poem by Tamil poet Subramania Bharati. The nomination marks the first time a Tamil song has been nominated for a Grammy, The Indian Express reported.

stories.headline: INDIA BEAT PAKISTAN 2–1 TO WIN RECORD 10TH SAFF TITLE
paragraphs: India came from behind to beat 10-man Pakistan 2–1 in Tuesday’s final in Dhaka, securing a record-extending 10th SAFF Championship crown.
Sandip Mandi scored the 88th-minute winner, completing India’s third consecutive title in the tournament.

stories.headline: AZAM KHAN GETS INTERIM BAIL AFTER SUPREME COURT AND ALLAHABAD HC RELIEF
paragraphs: The Supreme Court rejected Uttar Pradesh’s challenge to a stay on Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan’s conviction in a fake birth certificate case; the Allahabad High Court separately granted him interim bail in an ED money-laundering case.
The High Court said written grounds of arrest had not been supplied. Khan’s lawyer said he was likely to be released Wednesday.

stories.headline: PARTLY CLOUDY TODAY; NO CITY WARNING IN FORCE

paragraphs: The IMD forecast for Bengaluru on Wednesday is partly cloudy skies, with a minimum of 16°C and maximum of 29°C. No warning is in force.
